final_message:
I implemented `satisfies` and `maxSatisfying` in `src/range.ts` following the README. All 3 tests in `tests/range.test.ts` pass with `npm test`.

The implementation covers partial versions and wildcards, all comparator operators (including `^` and `~` with partial versions), hyphen ranges, and `||` sets. Invalid syntax throws even when another set would match. `maxSatisfying` validates the whole list and range up front, compares numerically, and returns the original string.

I also spot-checked about 35 README examples and error cases; they behaved as documented. Only `src/range.ts` changed.
